summary: 19 of 20 demo acceptance checks complete: verified fresh 18-step flow, narrated film, seven-page PDF and isolated tested source. Final public-link review and George clicking Submit remain. This is a hackathon prototype, not production readiness.
method: 20 explicit acceptance checks for the revised talking-Synth entry; this replaces the earlier dashboard checklist. Equal-weight check completion is not effort, quality or winning probability.
tagline: Turn order changes into approved work.

gates.title: A real local conversation
gates.detail: Apple FoundationModels interprets free text; tool results ground the order response.

gates.title: Voice note to useful answer
gates.detail: Local voice-file transcription returned the $1,750 proposal. George also confirmed the physical EarPods microphone and spoken reply both work.

gates.title: Company data drives the quote
gates.detail: Versioned, validated company stock and rates are read from a replaceable file; source SHA accompanies the result.

gates.title: Useful Hotdata scopes
gates.detail: Three role-specific databases returned inventory, shipping rates and policy. The inventory database rejected a query against the shipping catalog.

gates.title: Actual concurrent SQL
gates.detail: The newest live wave had 1,619 ms of overlapping SQL requests and returned the rows used for the quote. This measures overlap, not speedup.

gates.title: Cleanup and failure handling
gates.detail: Newest run removed all three databases; earlier network-failure leftovers reconciled with a scoped API list returning none. Expiry is only best effort.

gates.title: Exact proposal approval
gates.detail: 19 core tests pass. Exact approval binds quantity, price and option; saved packets identify their approval revision. Changed policy, source or failed replacement review clears old approval.

gates.title: A real saved deliverable
gates.detail: The actual conversation created an approved work packet through the captured Rote Play, including an unsent customer reply.

gates.title: Memory affects the next request
gates.detail: Persistence test: “Never split shipments” survives a fresh session and changes the feasible choice; raising budget then selects express.

gates.title: Cognee in the conversation
gates.detail: Actual Cognee raw-document retrieval restored an empty working cache to revision4 with three instructions and a prior approval. Fresh sessions use this memory. No semantic graph or embedding claim.

gates.title: HydraDB changes the working context
gates.detail: Actual conversation queried the deadline and shipment policy from HydraDB and supplied those returned constraints to the Rote review Play.

gates.title: Two captured Rote Plays
gates.detail: Both captured Plays ran with 100, 140 and 150 shirts. The packet Play refused a stale approval. Lint passed with optional presentation-fixture advice.

gates.title: RocketRide cloud execution
gates.detail: Actual served conversation used two cloud-returned proposals, then enforced the current approval fingerprint and saved the exact140/$1630packet. Both tasks terminated. No external model call.

gates.title: Within approved funding
gates.detail: Existing sponsor credits plus one expressly approved $10.50 Cloudflare purchase ($10 AI credit and $0.50 fee); automatic top-ups off. No Printful purchase. GPT Live route remains unavailable; Ava narration works.

gates.title: Honest sponsor evidence in the UI
gates.detail: Six sponsor roles and actual receipts are visible. Snyk is build-time; Cognee uses raw-document memory; RocketRide executes the deterministic cloud pipeline.

gates.title: All three talks transcribed
gates.detail: Full local ASR completed for 27, 28 and 29; quality review marks unrecoverable audio.

gates.title: Isolated runnable judge export
gates.detail: 213-file code candidate passed all 99 tests with credentials and private history excluded. Final media included in the exact-hash export.

gates.title: Security check of the submitted code
gates.detail: All four Snyk scans executed: main npm and Python clean; 16 Code findings and 29 Event development-dependency advisories remain disclosed.

gates.title: Room rehearsal and backup
gates.detail: Physical voice confirmed by George; full fresh 18-step take verified with two Hotdata waves, real cloud browser, Printful draft and owner email. Narrated film under two minutes verified.

gates.title: Judge-facing links and submission
gates.detail: Public GitHub and Cloudflare publication are being verified. Form is prepared for George to review and click Submit himself.
